notes.title: Milestone version upgrade (1.2.0)
notes.content:
[b]This is a milestone version, version 1.2.0.[/b]
[list]
[*] In this version, we have made considerable adjustments and invested a certain amount of energy in terms of scene diversity. Houses, buildings, and trees that can be destroyed or knocked down are carefully designed.
[*] In terms of weapons, we have also made bold innovations, adding small tracking missiles, bombs that bloom everywhere, Gatling cannons with blue fire that can destroy everything, super arc weapons, etc.
[*] In terms of game perspective control, we have added the tracking perspective of conventional tank games, which allows players to conveniently switch according to the scene and actual battlefield conditions. They can switch from the top view to the tracking perspective, allowing them to experience driving a tank to attack the enemy. It is fun and can also take into account the situation of the entire battlefield.
[*] At the same time, this version also fixes some bugs and optimizes the game system to make the game run more smoothly.
[*] The current version has adjusted the game mode, changing the two-player cooperative mode to a single-player stand-alone mode, because it is now very possible for a single person to play computer games at home, and the way a single person controls the mouse and keyboard can further explore the control of the game. potential, making players more comfortable.
[/list]
Come on, everyone. Come and experience a different gaming experience. ːsteamthisː

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 (Milestone) is ready to update.
notes.content:
The current version 1.2.0 adds new house models, tree models, new weapons and some new gameplay.
Fixed some bugs.
Change the two-player cooperative mode to a single-player stand-alone mode, because now it is very possible for a single person to play computer games at home, and the way a single person controls the mouse and keyboard can further tap into the game's control potential, making players more comfortable.

notes.title: Major new version upgrade 1.1.0
notes.content:
Current version 1.1.0
[b]Upgrade content[/b]:
[list]
[*] First, a new weapon has been added: scattering mines.
[*] Second, a new weapon has been added: arc.
[*] Third, a new weapon has been added: small missiles.
[*] Fourth, some game bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
Weapons are randomly dropped after destroying enemy tanks. Arc weapons and small missile weapons can be picked up through triggers (driving the tank over). For scattering mine weapons, you need to use artillery to bombard them. After a few bombardments, the scattering mines will explode and scatter all over the battlefield. They will explode after a few seconds and can cause certain damage to enemy tanks.
Arc weapons can conduct electric current attacks on enemy tanks in areas relatively close to the player. This weapon requires a certain amount of charging time.
Small missile weapons can track and attack enemy tanks within a certain distance. Small missile weapons can automatically seek targets.
